findings.title: The annular purge gap bounded by the core body bore is described for the seat ring only
findings.attack: Claims 16-18 recite a purge gap 'bounded by an outer surface of the radially deflectable element and by a bore', 'a core body bore (22)', 'annular'. [0124] and [0185] describe the clearance for the seat ring 30 only; no passage describes it for the slotted sleeve, split seat ring, tapered seat ring or wiper ring, so an amendment path on a generic element lacks combination support.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add one sentence that, for each form of the radially deflectable element whose outer surface faces the core body bore, the purge gap may be an annular clearance between them.

findings.title: The detent is not disclosed in combination with the other features as an alternative to the two-rate characteristic
findings.attack: Claim 6 requires 'a two-rate characteristic'; [0148] discloses a detent giving 'a step in force in place of a change of rate' once only, with no statement or combination. A detent design falls outside claim 6, and amending claim 1 to cover 'a two-rate characteristic or a detent' with the ranges, purge shoulder or seat ring draws an intermediate-generalisation objection.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a numbered statement for the detent on statement 1.3 and a sentence that the detent may replace the two-rate characteristic in each combination and with the ranges of [0238] and [0239].

findings.title: The fit band and relief have no numbered combination, and none with the polymer seat ring
findings.attack: Claim 26: 'the interference fit acts on a fit band (35) ... a free portion (37) which ... expands into a core body bore relief (202)'. [0186] ties the fit band to the interference fit and locating shoulder; no statement combines them, and FIG. 8 instructions exclude the fit band from the polymer seat ring. Amendment taking the relief alone, or with claims 30-31, lacks basis.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a numbered statement combining seat ring, interference fit on a fit band next to the locating shoulder, free portion and core body bore relief, and state whether it applies to the polymer seat ring 130.

findings.title: Wall slots: location and closing mechanism narrower in [0190] than in the claims
findings.attack: Claims 44 and 67 recite 'wall slots (204) ... closed at rest and open on the radial expansion'; [0190] places them 'in the free portion 37, below the sealing edge 32' with two specific closing means. An examiner may treat the unlocated slot as an intermediate generalisation, though statement 1.14 gives general basis.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a sentence that the wall slots may be at any position in the convoluted wall outside the main passage and closed at rest by any of the means described, if the inventor so conceived.

findings.title: Example 1 does not state the convolution count, return-spring construction or purge-gap boundary of the tested cores
findings.attack: [0279] says only that the return spring 'had a two-rate characteristic' and the seat ring 'had a convoluted wall 34'. Without the number of convolutions, the spring construction and the purge-gap boundary of the tested cores, a fallback to the tested embodiment cannot be combined with any of those features without an intermediate generalisation, and the data cannot be tied to one or two convolutions.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add to Example 1 the number of convolutions, the return-spring construction and the purge-gap boundary of P-1 to P-3, from the inventor's records.

assumptions.text: A1. This review is a drafting and analysis aid, not legal advice. Qualified patent counsel decides what is filed and how to amend.
A2. The rejection assumed for the paths is illustrative; no prior-art reference is applied or cited as anticipating any claim.

A3. Added-matter and intermediate-generalisation risk is assessed on the EPO directly-and-unambiguously-derivable standard; the UK applies the same test, and US written description on amendment is treated as at least as demanding.
A4. The numbered claim-support statements at [0297]-[0348] are part of the description as filed and count as basis in the combinations they state.

open_questions.text: Q1. For prototypes P-1 to P-3: how many convolutions, how was the two-rate characteristic produced, and was the purge gap bounded by a plain core body bore?
Q2. Does the inventor regard the detent of [0148] as an alternative to the two-rate characteristic in every combination, including with the pressure ranges?
Q3. Do the fit band and core body bore relief apply to the polymer seat ring, and may the wall slots be anywhere in the convoluted wall outside the main passage?
